text:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO [hosted-inference/5xx-rate] crossed threshold (3%) — us-west1 — 5m window. trigger_ts=1792201234 :rotating_light:

Anna (SRE): seeing a sudden bump in 5xx and gateway timeouts starting ~09:47 UTC. spikes in 502/504 from api-gateway and 500 from runtime pods. Multiple customer escalations coming in. :fire:

Lucia (support): reporting from two paid customers: repeated failures during generation, some requests billing but no output. They sent sample request IDs: r_8a7f... and r_c3d4...

Mike (SRE): digging traces — span tree shows gateway waiting on downstream inference-runtime for ~12s before return with 500. Some requests produce long tail >10s, causing gateway 504s.

Tara (eng-runtime): any recent deploys? I see a canary rollout of model-route "llama-tiling-v2" at 09:30 UTC (10% traffic). Not sure if it affects KV cache behavior.

Anna (SRE): rolling timeline: \n- 09:30 canary model-route deploy (llama-tiling-v2)\n- 09:42 small bump in p95 latency on runtime\n- 09:47 5xx rate climbs to 4.8%\n- 09:50 several gateway 504s

obs-bot: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/hosted-inference/ops?panel=5 (linked alert grafana)

Mike (SRE): logs query I'm using (Cloud Logging/Loki style):

```
resource.type="k8s_container" AND labels.k8s_container_name="inference-runtime"\njsonPayload.level>=ERROR AND (jsonPayload.message =~ "timeout|deadline|kvcache|oom|500")
| sort timestamp desc | limit 200
```

Found repeated errors: "kv-cache miss and long fetch", "failed to allocate kv-shard", and intermittent OOM kill traces around 09:46-09:49 on runtime-2-pod-3.

Tara (eng-runtime): OOMs? Our new tiled attention feature increased working set for some model classes. Canary should have resource requests but maybe not for larger sequences. Checking pod metrics.

Jay (infra): node autoscaler didn't spin up more nodes; cluster CPU hit 88% in the window. autoscaler logs show scaling delay 130s (backoff).

Anna (SRE): probable sequence: canary model variant causes larger memory use -> pod OOMs / stall -> runtime emits internal 500s / long response -> api-gateway times out and surfaces 504/502 to clients. Also gaps in tracing for KV lookups (we're sampling too low for this route).

Action proposals (short term):
- rollback canary to 0% routing ASAP (Tara) :arrow_backward:
- temporarily increase gateway upstream timeout from 8s -> 15s to reduce 504 noise while we fix (Mike + infra) :gear:
- scale up runtime replica count and node pool to absorb load (Jay) :rocket:
- add emergency alert for OOM and runtime-internal-5xx with 1m window (Anna)

Tara (eng-runtime): rolling canary -> 0% now. command:

```
# internal rollout CLI
redwood rollout set --route llama-tiling-v2 --percent 0 --env hosted-us-west1
```

Mike (SRE): increasing gateway timeout on staging to test first; if good, do prod change. Config snippet:

```
# api-gateway config
upstreams:
  hosted-inference:
    timeout: 15s # was 8s
```

Lucia (support): I'll inform the two customers and ask for request IDs to re-run after rollback. Keeping them updated. :thumbsup:

obs-bot: trace-sampler note: sampling_rate=0.1 for inference routes — increasing to 0.5 for 30m to capture more KV/worker spans.

Mike (SRE): reproduction steps for devs if you want to stress:

```
# reproduce long-tail behavior (approx)
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"llama-tiling-v2","input":"<long sequence>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done
```

Expect a few requests to hang >8s and then 500 from runtime if workspace memory blows.

Anna (SRE): current mitigations in progress:
- canary rolled back at 09:56 (Tara)
- runtime replicas scaled +2 at 09:58 (Jay)
- prod gateway timeout temporarily 12s at 10:01 (Mike)
- trace sampling bumped at 10:02 (obs-bot)

Initial indicators: 5xx rate dropped to 2.1% in the next 5m window, gateway 504s reduced but still above baseline.

Next steps / action items: 
- Tara: investigate memory profile for llama-tiling-v2 and add resource requests/limits per sequence-length. (P0)
- Mike: revert gateway timeout change after 24h if stable and create a runbook for dynamic upstream timeouts. (P1)
- Jay: tune autoscaler to be less conservative for inference node pool, add on-call playbook. (P1)
- Anna: add a short-lived alert for runtime-internal-5xx & OOM, and augment logs to include model-route and request-id in error traces. (P0)
- Lucia: follow up with affected customers and confirm replays succeed. (P1)

Mike (SRE): logging note — several traces show missing KV-cache spans. We should instrument KV shard lookup with a unique span id for easier joins in traces. Will open a PR.

Tara (eng-runtime): I'll open a postmortem once we have root cause confirmation; pushing a fix for memory usage and add canary gating for memory delta.

Anna (SRE): locking this thread to keep incident timeline consolidated. Will update when we see 24h stable metric. :lock:

Lucia (support): customers acknowledged updates. One asks for ETA for permanent fix. I'll pass along the RC details once Tara posts timeline. :eyes:
